command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin; fi
ops_home=$(getent passwd opsadmin | cut -d: -f6)
install -d -m 700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin "$ops_home/.ssh"
if [ ! -f "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa" ]; then
  runuser -u opsadmin -- ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 3072 -N '' -f "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa"
fi
cat "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa.pub" > "$ops_home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
awk -v host="$NODE_IP" '{print host, $1, $2}' /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key.pub > "$ops_home/.ssh/known_hosts"
printf 'Host %s\n  HostName %s\n  User opsadmin\n  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_rsa\n  IdentitiesOnly yes\n  BatchMode yes\n  StrictHostKeyChecking yes\n  HostKeyAlgorithms rsa-sha2-512,rsa-sha2-256\n  UserKnownHostsFile ~/.ssh/known_hosts\n' "$NODE_IP" "$NODE_IP" > "$ops_home/.ssh/config"
chown opsadmin:opsadmin "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa" "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa.pub" "$ops_home/.ssh/authorized_keys" "$ops_home/.ssh/known_hosts" "$ops_home/.ssh/config"
chmod 600 "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa" "$ops_home/.ssh/authorized_keys" "$ops_home/.ssh/known_hosts" "$ops_home/.ssh/config"
chmod 644 "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa.pub"
restorecon -RF "$ops_home/.ssh" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'configured_user=%s home=%s\n' "$(id -un opsadmin)" "$ops_home"
printf 'client_key='; ssh-keygen -lf "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa.pub"
printf 'pinned_host_key='; ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key.pub
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' "$ops_home/.ssh" "$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa" "$ops_home/.ssh/authorized_keys" "$ops_home/.ssh/known_hosts" "$ops_home/.ssh/config"

command:
set -eu
ops_home=$(getent passwd opsadmin | cut -d: -f6)
test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opsadmin-hostkey-test.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' EXIT
ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 3072 -N '' -f "$test_dir/fake_host_rsa"
awk -v host="$NODE_IP" '{print host, $1, $2}' "$test_dir/fake_host_rsa.pub" > "$test_dir/known_hosts"
chown -R opsadmin:opsadmin "$test_dir"
chmod 700 "$test_dir"
chmod 600 "$test_dir/known_hosts"
set +e
runuser -u opsadmin -- ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o HostKeyAlgorithms=rsa-sha2-512,rsa-sha2-256 -o UserKnownHostsFile="$test_dir/known_hosts" -o IdentityFile="$ops_home/.ssh/id_rsa" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" true >"$test_dir/out" 2>"$test_dir/err"
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'mismatched_host_key_exit=%s\n' "$rc"
sed -n '/REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED/p;/Host key verification failed/p' "$test_dir/err"
[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]
grep -Eq 'REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED|Host key verification failed' "$test_dir/err"
printf '%s\n' 'unexpected_host_key_rejected=PASS'
